definitions.gloss: the on-reading of a kanji — the Japanese pronunciation of a Chinese character derived from its original Chinese reading
definitions.explanation: Refers to the pronunciation of a kanji that was borrowed from Chinese, as opposed to its native Japanese reading. For example, the {字音|じおん} of {山|さん} is さん (as in {登山|とざん}), while its native reading is やま. Used in linguistic, educational, and dictionary contexts to contrast with {訓読|くんよ}み.

examples.english: Kanji have both on-readings and kun-readings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{熟語|じゅくご}→熟語：04219_jukugo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多|おお}く⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{字音|じおん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{読|よ}まれる→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: Most compound words are read using on-readings.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{字音|じおん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧カタカナ、⟦{訓読|くんよ}み→訓読み：10454_kunyomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ひらがな⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{示|しめ}している→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: In this dictionary, on-readings are shown in katakana and kun-readings in hiragana.

notes:
A linguistic and lexicographic term for the Chinese-derived reading of a kanji. In technical discussion, often contrasted explicitly with {訓|くん} (native Japanese reading).

USAGE:
- Encountered in dictionaries, linguistics textbooks, and discussions about Japanese writing and etymology.
- Closely synonymous with ⟦{音読|おんよ}み→音読み：10453_onyomi⟧ in most contexts, though {字音|じおん} is slightly more technical and often used in academic writing.
- In general everyday conversation, ⟦{音読|おんよ}み→音読み：10453_onyomi⟧ is far more common than {字音|じおん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {字音|じおん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{訓|くん}: on-reading and kun-reading
- {字音|じおん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read using the on-reading
- {字音|じおん}{仮名遣|かなづか}い: historical kana spelling of Sino-Japanese readings
- {呉音|ごおん}・{漢音|かんおん}・{唐音|とうおん}: Go, Kan, and Tō layers of on-readings

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{音読|おんよ}み→音読み：10453_onyomi⟧: on-reading — the everyday, commonly used term for the same concept.
- ⟦{訓読|くんよ}み→訓読み：10454_kunyomi⟧: kun-reading — the native Japanese reading, the opposite category.
- {字訓|じくん}: kun-reading in a technical/academic sense, paralleling {字音|じおん}.

REGISTER:
Mildly technical; standard in linguistics and lexicography. In casual or classroom contexts, ⟦{音読|おんよ}み→音読み：10453_onyomi⟧ is preferred.
